Description: The lifecycle module labels checksums as JCS canonicalization over caller-supplied canonical bytes, but it does not parse or enforce JSON canonicalization. This is visible as a deferred boundary, but downstream persistence/hash use must not treat the label alone as proof of DEL-02-05 canonical JSON/JCS-compatible hashing.
ProposedDisposition: Technical resolution implemented: sha256_jcs was replaced with sha256_caller_supplied_jcs_bytes, and runtime canonicalization now records CallerSuppliedJcsBytesUnverified instead of JCS proof. README and rule-pack schema expose the unverified caller-supplied checksum basis. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/rules/rule_pack_lifecycle/Cargo.toml passed. Proposed human disposition: accept technical resolution after REVIEW confirmation.
